text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"The Centaur Stakes...
It is an important race, but..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This is merely a prelude.
The real deal is... next.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Sprinters Stakes is the real showdown.
However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "It just so happens that we're both here for the same 1200m race—me and Believe. Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just have the Sprinters Stakes today?
Strike while the iron is hot, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm not... really sure.
What is truly right, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "For Believe-san and Light O-san, this may just be a preliminary skirmish. But—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To me, it is different.
Isn't that right, Trainer-dono?
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is the real deal!
Yeah, this is the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we weren't planning to run in the Sprinters Stakes,
we were prepped and tuned almost to the absolute max.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 1200m GⅡ featuring Senior Class runners.
If her closing kick can prove even somewhat effective here, the outlook for next year will open up dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, with this distance and this opponent,
I cannot afford to boast.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I will certainly land a blow on them.
To show that a knight is here!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's challenge them fair and square!
Yeah, let's take on the challenge fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Believe-san, Light O-san, I look forward to working with you."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"After this, I will likely make my return
to the mile division. However—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I cannot shamelessly retreat without achieving any results!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
1,200 meters—it's over in a flash.
Even so, I shall show you!
The Holy Sword flashing even in that split second!
